question: does an ORACLE-DISTINCT decomposed-energy verifier (mean-ranks/stddev-abstains quality ensemble + analytical penalty) beat self-consistency on a non-saturated no-cheap-oracle domain (arXiv:2605.18871)?

oracle_distinctness.note: gold (answer_choice) is used for EVAL accuracy ONLY; never passed to the generator, the quality scorer, the analytical penalty, or the judge. The energy decomposition is -mean(quality_ensemble)+analytical_penalty; uncertainty=stddev abstains to SC.
oracle_distinctness.no_model_identity_shortcut: all candidates come from ONE generator model; the scorer ranks by reasoning quality, not by candidate model_id (no model_id field is read).

interpretation: First REAL execution of the post-6/30 distributional-energy-verifier pivot on a non-saturated, no-cheap-oracle domain (the headroom ARC's generation wall cannot host). A win (energy beats SC, CI excludes 0, oracle-distinct) is the verifier-moat result; a null scopes the moat. CAVEAT: the quality scorer is an LLM process-reward ensemble (THINKPRM-style), not yet a TRAINED EBM LoRA-ensemble -- a positive justifies training the real EBM scorer next; this is the cheapest decisive first test of the oracle-distinct-energy-beats-SC thesis off ARC. RESULT: cheap prompted decomposed-energy verifier is a NULL vs SC (26 vs 29/50, delta -0.06, CI incl 0). BUT the LLM-judge beats SC (32 vs 29/50) -> the moat headroom on MuSR is REAL and reachable by a holistic verifier; the decomposed process-reward energy underperformed it. Next: a better energy formulation OR the TRAINED LoRA-EBM quality scorer (the real arXiv:2605.18871 method, which a prompted stand-in only approximates). The judge>SC signal keeps the off-ARC verifier-moat thesis alive; do NOT conclude energy-cannot-help from this cheap-stand-in null.
tautology_methodology_note: energy_minus_sc_delta and energy_pure_minus_sc_delta both = -0.06 because energy(with-abstain) and energy(pure) both scored EXACTLY 26/50: the abstain mechanism flipped the selected answer on only 2 of 13 abstained questions, and on those 2 the SC-pick and the min-energy-pick each got 1 right (netting even). Verified per-question -> a genuine small-n (n=50, 0.02 granularity) coincidence, NOT a bug. adversarial_verify TAUTOLOGY here is a known small-n false-positive class.
surprising_result_acknowledgment: the LLM-judge (0.64) is numerically above SC (0.58) but McNemar p~=0.51 (NOT significant at n=50); the energy verifier (0.52) is a clean null. NO method beats SC significantly here. Needs n>=200 to test for real headroom; do NOT call headroom "real" from n=50.
flagged_adversarial_disclosure: adversarial_verify raises CRITICAL TAUTOLOGY on energy_minus_sc_delta==energy_pure_minus_sc_delta (both -0.06). INSPECTED per-question (see tautology_methodology_note): both energy variants legitimately scored 26/50 because the abstain mechanism flipped only 2/13 abstentions and those netted even. This is the known small-n two-accuracies-coincide false-positive class (cf. CLAUDE.md TAUTOLOGY-excludes-identifiers note), NOT fabrication. Result is oracle-distinct (verifier never sees gold), informative (methods differ on 9 q), n=50.
significance_note: CORRECTION (adversarial review 2026-06-29): at n=50 NO method significantly beats self-consistency. energy vs SC: clean null (delta -0.06, CI incl 0). judge vs SC: +0.06 BUT McNemar exact p~=0.51, bootstrap CI [-0.06,+0.18] incl 0 -> WITHIN SAMPLING NOISE, not significant. The earlier "headroom is REAL" framing OVERSTATED a noise-level judge result; the defensible statement is "judge >= SC but indistinguishable from noise at n=50". Establishing off-ARC verifier headroom requires replication at n>=200 before any forward-facing headroom claim.
